subject: Human Evolution
title: The Obstetric Dilemma
description: A quick, practical guide to The Obstetric Dilemma.

hook.text: Human babies are born helpless. Chimp babies cling to their mothers within hours. Why the difference?

buildup.text: Bipedalism narrowed the pelvis, shrinking the birth canal just as brain size was increasing.

discovery.text: Babies must be born 'early'—with underdeveloped brains—to fit through. This is the obstetric dilemma.

twist.text: Some researchers argue metabolism, not the pelvis, limits pregnancy length—the 'EGG' hypothesis.

climax.text: Either way, human birth is uniquely difficult because walking upright redesigned the exit route.

punchline.text: Walking made birth painful and babies helpless.

quiz.question: What is the obstetric dilemma?
options: Bipedalism narrowed the birth canal while brains grew
